## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes (or: could not run, because …)

## Checklist

- [ ] Every number the panel shows comes from the session, and unavailable data is marked as such
- [ ] No keys, tokens, personal paths or machine-specific files are included
- [ ] Screenshots, if any, come from the running panel (not from `npm run assets`)
- [ ] README or CHANGELOG updated if behavior changed
